title: Patient Financial Account Terms — Prompt-Pay Discount on a Charge
content:
**Term 1 — The discount.** A patient who pays the full remaining balance of one charge on the Patient Financial Account inside the tier's prompt-pay window receives the tier's prompt-pay discount percentage off that remaining balance, posted as one adjustment coded as a prompt-pay discount on the charge. The settling payment is the remaining balance less the discount. The discount is the remaining balance multiplied by the percentage, rounded to the nearest cent. A charge's remaining balance is its amount less every time-of-service collection, payment and adjustment applied to it, plus the amount of any of those payments later reversed.

**Term 2 — The window.** The payment is received no later than the tier's prompt-pay window counted from the posting date of the charge. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the posting date, and a payment received on the last day of the window qualifies. The posting date is the one on the charge's own ledger line.

**Term 3 — Minimum.** The charge's remaining balance is at least the tier's prompt-pay minimum.

**Term 4 — Which tier.** The tier is the one in force on the charge's date of service. A tier whose prompt-pay discount percentage is 0.00 — the Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage accounts — never grants it.

**Term 5 — Once only; partial payments.** A charge receives the prompt-pay discount at most once. A partial payment earns nothing.

**Term 6 — Stacking.**
- On a self-pay service the discount is computed on the remaining balance after the self-pay discount.
- The prompt-pay discount and a hardship adjustment are mutually exclusive on the same charge, so a charge that already carries a hardship adjustment receives no prompt-pay discount.
- Fees — no-show, late cancellation, late fee, returned payment, records, membership — never earn it.
- A charge enrolled in a payment plan earns no prompt-pay discount, even if the plan is paid off early.

**Term 7 — Account status.** The account status is active, billing hold or precollection when the discount is posted.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A service line on a tier with a 5.00 percent discount and a 100.00 minimum has a remaining balance of 180.00. The discount is 180.00 multiplied by 5.00 percent, that is 9.00, and the settling payment is 180.00 less 9.00, that is 171.00. A payment of 90.00 toward the same charge is partial and earns nothing.

### Window boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Payment received | Inside the window? |
|---|---|
| day 30 after the posting date | yes — the last day qualifies |
| day 31 after the posting date | no |

### Eligibility at a glance

| Condition | Must hold |
|---|---|
| full remaining balance paid inside the window | yes |
| remaining balance at least the tier's minimum | yes |
| tier rate above 0.00 | yes |
| no earlier prompt-pay discount and no hardship adjustment on the charge | yes |
| charge is not a fee (no-show, late cancellation, late fee, returned payment, records, membership) | yes |
| charge not enrolled in a payment plan | yes |
| account active, billing hold or precollection | yes |
